cells.text:
Performs an acrobatic leap, that, upon landing, grants the user and their allies within 10 meters Radiant for 10+5 seconds.
Enemies within 6.5 meters are dealt up to 40 [20] Solar Damage upon landing.

clarity.conflict: Both descriptions still require ground activation, but their lastUpload is from 2024. Official 9.7.0 explicitly permits airborne activation and takes precedence.

official.fact: Acrobats Dodge can now be activated while airborne.

engine_dependency: Generic capture_input_direction captures held movement input independently of facing and velocity, and distinguishes observed neutral from unavailable observations. Existing capture_direction still supplies LOOK/HORIZONTAL facing without storage-shape changes. The prerequisite passed core tests and full Fabric / NeoForge world gates; Acrobat content remains pending.
pending: Modern airborne completion timing is unresolved. Required completion_delay represents a calibrated animation-phase policy in these reference tests, not proof that physical terrain contact is or is not required.

Synthetic impulses are 6 m/s horizontal plus 4 m/s upward, idle direction is backward and completion delay is .2 s. No original animation, displacement curve, friction compensation, velocity replacement or client prediction has been measured.

Synthetic blast falloff is linear from full at zero to zero at 6.5 meters, with .1 damage-unit projection. Public peak/radius values do not establish this curve or world conversion. Damage classification follows combatant / Guardian targets independently of the mode-specific cooldown.
Ascension shared delay .2 s and whether its selected dodge transfers the Solar explosion remain unverified. The event is a Chorus content extension point, not a newly claimed Bungie lifecycle event.

Class regeneration stat curve and any Acrobat-specific damage scaling above 100 Class are not inferred from Ascension. Full exotics/fragments/mod interactions, animation, formal subclass assembly, HUD, assets and physical-world persistence remain incomplete.
